lineage.scope: Ported integer,median,pooled/cell-support arithmetic; two declared groups and bounded generic dimensions. No mutable research imports.

integer_safety: 512*256*10000000=1310720000000 < 2^53 and int64 max; bound every N and T element before accumulation. maximum_count is per element, not a total UMI cap.

n_cells_group.definition: All fixed cells assigned to this declared group.

total_terminal_UMI.definition: Sum of the group's T for this fixed gene, or all fixed genes for a group summary; not independent RNA expression.

n_cells_T_zero.definition: Count T=0; missing APA evidence, not biological zero usage.

median_T_all_cells.definition: Median over all group cells, including zeros.

median_T_positive_cells.definition: Median over T>0 cells; null if none, never substituted with zero.

n_fixed_eligible_PAS.definition: Size of this supplied gene block, K>=2; upstream eligibility is declared, not independently certified.

n_PAS_positive_pooled_within_group.definition: Count of fixed PAS with a positive sum across all cells in this group.

pooled_PAS_counts_in_frozen_order.definition: Group sums, every fixed PAS retained in original feature order, including zeros.

PAS_identities_in_frozen_order.definition: Original feature index,native order and peak string, without reordering or coercion.

second_largest_pooled_PAS_count_in_group.definition: Second largest count among all fixed PAS; zero when fewer than2 are positive. Not distal/proximal identity.

n_cells_with_at_least_two_positive_PAS.definition: Cells with >=2 positive fixed PAS within this gene; not pooled multi-site support.

fraction_cells_T_positive.definition: All group cells are the denominator; not a percentile or p-value.

fraction_cells_with_at_least_two_positiv.definition: All group cells are the denominator.

total_retained_gene_UMI.definition: Cell sum of T over all fixed gene blocks.

n_genes_with_at_least_two_positive_PAS.definition: Fixed genes with >=2 positive PAS within this cell.

n_genes_positive_T_both_groups.definition: Genes with positive pooled T in BOTH declared groups; reported once outside group marginals.

n_genes_at_least_two_positive_pooled_PAS.definition: Genes with >=2 positive pooled PAS in BOTH groups; neither marginal, their minimum nor all-cell pooling.

summary_counts.definition: n_cells,n_genes,n_PAS and global_terminal_UMI describe this fixed supplied bundle.

per_cell_summary_statistics.definition: min/median/max over all fixed group cells; no new filtering or adequacy gate.

identity.definition: Identifiers including001/NA/UTF8 remain strings; only explicit ordinal index columns are integers.

n_cells.definition: All fixed supplied cells; within a group summary, all fixed cells in that declared group.

n_genes.definition: All supplied fixed gene blocks, with none filtered.

n_PAS.definition: All supplied fixed PAS, including globally zero sites.

global_terminal_UMI.definition: Sum of T across every fixed supplied cell and gene; not independent RNA expression.

interpretation_limits: T=0 is missing APA evidence, not biological zero usage.
No row/feature selection,upstream-filter diagnosis,R2,null,UMAP,p-value,effect-size,power or biological inference.
Declared sample context, successful execution, integrity, scientific review and native completion are different claims.
Hashes establish bounded byte consistency, not owner approval, provenance authenticity or a hostile-host sandbox.
numeric_export: Raw integers and null retained; float64 views in TSV use.17g and are actually reparsed, then checked against JSON.
